items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Oh, yeah, Peter Hunter, wouldn't let him touch it.

ctx.x: Well, that's what my dad put on me with that trumpet. That's what he told me.
Oh, yeah, Peter Hunter, wouldn't let him touch it.
He's the one who bought that Octolang book. He bought me that first before they sent me the horn.
